newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks soar 3.54 percent at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks soar 3.54 percent at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared to end 3.54 percent up on Sunday in a bull run powered by hopes that Nawaz Sharif will win Monday's election, dealers said.
"Prospects of a pro-business leader becoming the next prime minister has lifted investors' spirits," dealer Ali Asghar said.
A post-election rally could take the index through the 1,600-point barrier on Tuesday if Sharif emerged a clear victor.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 54.27 points to close at 1,588.48 with 189 gainers and 29 losers. Hub Power Co rose 1.70 rupees to 41.40 and PTCL 1.30 to 34.60.

Bank of Punjab rose 5.0 rupees to 31, Muslim Commercial Bank 1.25 to 36.75, Askari Bank 3.0 to 33, Dewan Salman Fibre 2.95 to 39.70, D.G. Khan Cement 1.05 to 13.60, Hub Power Co 1.70 to 41.40 and Pakistan State Oil 4.0 to 291. PTCL rose 1.30 to 34.60, ICI Pakistan 2.30 to 22.45 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 1.25 to 16.75.
